# clio backup list

List snapshots newest first by manifest time (no database needed); --db and --backend are refused because they cannot change the listing

## Usage

```
clio backup list [--limit N] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

reads each archive's manifest only: no payload, no database, so it works with the store down. Every row states its backend. --db and --backend are refused because they cannot change the listing

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit N` | uint |  | Caps the rows returned; `backup_list_cli::limit` refuses a value that is not a count. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

List every snapshot, newest first.
```
clio backup list
```

Cap the listing at five snapshots.
```
clio backup list --limit 5
```

Emit the rows as JSON.
```
clio backup list -o json
```
